chunks: That it is disliked to marry during the waning phase of the month.

key_terms.التَّزْوِيجُ: marriage or the act of marrying
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates a reported transmission without a full sanad/isnad here
key_terms.مُحَاقِ: the moon’s waning or disappearing phase at the end of the lunar month
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: it is considered disliked or discouraged in legal usage

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to marry during the waning phase of the moon in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that marriage is considered makruh during the muhaq of the month, meaning the phase when the moon wanes and disappears from sight. It reflects a legal discouragement concerning timing in marriage, as transmitted in the hadith literature.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: It is narrated that "It is disliked to marry during the waning phase of the moon."
